# Copilot Instructions for The Book of Robocode

Start at [`/AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). It holds the global rules, the article workflow, and links to the detailed
instructions in `/.agents/instructions/`.

Skills live in `/.agents/skills/`:

- `create-page/SKILL.md`: `/create-page <Page Name>` writes, illustrates, reviews, and integrates a new page.
- `create-illustration/SKILL.md`: `/create-illustration` draws SVGs from the page's illustration markers.
- `review-page/SKILL.md`: `/review-page` reviews a page for structure, accuracy, voice, and images.
